properties.snippet: These boundaries represent the Kansas Office of Veterans Services facility service areas. Attributes include service area counties, contact information and address. Layer updated May 2025.
properties.description:
The Kansas Office of Veterans Services (KOVS) continues to help our state's veterans and their families to improve the quality of their lives. From helping veterans to file claims for education, medical or other benefits, to assisting them in obtaining earned medals and military awards, KOVS is here to serve you. The wide array of available programs and services are provided by a grateful nation and state. To help obtain these benefits, the KOVS provides Veteran Service Representatives (VSRs) free-of-charge to assist veterans and their families with applying for benefits. State VSRs are available in strategic locations across Kansas or through grants provided to National Service Organizations, such as the American Legion and Veterans of Foreign Wars. Data reviewed and updated May 2025.

Other KOVS benefits includes Dependency Indemnity Compensation (Spouse/Child/Parent), Death Pension (Spouse), VA Health Care, Education Benefits, Veteran Readiness and Employment, VA Home Loans, VA Life Insurance, State Veterans Cemeteries, request your discharge paperwork, Kansas Vietnam Medal and Certificate, Free Hunting and Fishing License, Claims Appeals, Kansas Veterans Homes for Long Term Care and Assisted Living, and more.

Who is eligible? Veterans who were discharged from service under conditions other than dishonorable, AND served at least 90 days of active service, which one day was during a wartime period; AND the household family income meets the pension rate criteria, AND the Veteran is is age 65 or older, OR permanently and totally disabled.

The full Kansas geospatial catalog is administered by the Kansas Data Access & Support Center (DASC) and can be found at the following URL: https://hub.kansasgis.org/
